body:
Your private order page at One Stop Vape Store shows a status. Each status tells you what is happening to your order and what, if anything, you should do next. Understanding them takes the guesswork out of waiting, and it helps you spot when something needs attention. This guide explains every status in the order you are likely to see it, what triggers each change, how long each usually lasts, what to do at each stage and what to do if an order seems stuck. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## How statuses work
An order moves forward through a short sequence as payment is received and confirmed and the parcel is prepared and shipped. Some statuses depend on you, such as paying or uploading proof. Others depend on us, such as confirming payment and shipping. Some are automatic, such as a crypto payment being detected on the network. The status changes on your private page, and you receive an email at key points, so you do not have to keep refreshing. The link to your page is in your confirmation email.

## Awaiting payment
We have your order but no confirmed payment. This is the first status for every order. What to do depends on the method:

- **Cryptocurrency:** make or complete the transfer, and press "I have paid" in the payment window. See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/).
- **Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime:** watch for our details, which usually arrive within minutes in business hours. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).
- **Gift cards:** buy the card and upload it through the private link. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

Pay within 24 hours of ordering, because unpaid orders may be released so stock is not held indefinitely.

## Payment details sent
We emailed or messaged you the details. Pay the exact amount, add your order ID in the note and upload your receipt. If you have not received the details, check spam and the email address you entered, and contact us if they do not arrive. See [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/).

## Proof submitted
You uploaded a screenshot, a transaction hash or gift card details. A team member is reviewing it, normally within business hours, Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 7PM Pacific Standard Time. You do not need to do anything unless we contact you. If you uploaded the wrong image or need to add information, tell us and upload again. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## Payment detected on-chain
For crypto, a transfer is visible on the network but not fully confirmed yet. This is automatic, and no action is needed unless it stays that way for a long time. The time depends on the network: Solana and Tron are usually quick, Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain take a few minutes, and Bitcoin often needs a block confirmation of around ten minutes. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/). If the status shows underpaid instead, see [why your crypto payment shows underpaid](/blog/why-your-crypto-payment-shows-underpaid/).

## Payment confirmed
We have confirmed your payment, and your order enters processing. You receive an email. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours, and most orders ship within 48 hours. Business days are Monday to Friday, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays. Your order may also be reviewed to ensure security and accuracy, and if so we will contact you the same day. You do not need to do anything, but this is the last point at which changes are easy, so tell us now if something needs to change. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Shipped
Your package is on its way. A tracking email follows with the carrier and tracking number. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created. Delivery needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/). Estimated transit is 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US.

## Cancelled
The order was cancelled. The most common reason is that payment was not received in time. An order can also be cancelled at your request before it ships, or if it cannot be fulfilled lawfully, for example if the address is outside our shipping area. If you paid and the order is cancelled, refunds follow our policy and go back through the payment method used. If you did not expect the cancellation, contact us right away with your order ID.

## A typical sequence
For a crypto order: awaiting payment, payment detected, payment confirmed, shipped. For an app order: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment confirmed, shipped. For a gift card order: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment confirmed, shipped. Some steps pass quickly and you may not see them, because the page updates as events happen.

## How long should each status last?
- **Awaiting payment:** minutes to a few hours, depending on how quickly you pay.
- **Payment details sent:** until you pay.
- **Proof submitted:** typically within business hours of uploading.
- **Payment detected:** minutes, longer for Bitcoin.
- **Payment confirmed:** 24 to 72 business hours of processing.
- **Shipped:** the carrier's transit time, 3 to 7 or 11 to 18 business days depending on your region.

## What to do if stuck
If an order sits in one status longer than expected, contact us from the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. Tell us the status you see and when it last changed. Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) for the typical timeline. Do not pay twice, and do not resend crypto, until we have checked what we can see.

## Emails you will receive
You receive an email when your order is placed, when payment details are sent where relevant, when payment is confirmed and when the order ships with tracking. If you do not see one, check spam. Emails come from our official address and always show your order ID.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I see the history of my statuses?
Your page shows the current status and the key updates. If you need the full history, contact us with your order ID.

### Does a status change mean something went wrong?
No. Statuses are normal stages. Only a long wait in one status, or a cancelled status you did not expect, calls for action.

### Can I go back to an earlier status?
Statuses move forward. If something needs to be redone, such as a second payment for a balance, we explain in the notes.

### Who updates the status?
Some changes are automatic, such as crypto detection. Others are made by our team after a check, such as confirming an app or gift card payment and marking an order shipped.

Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and see [uploading proof](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for more. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Reading statuses alongside your emails
### The email trail
Each important status change comes with an email. The first confirms your order and gives you the order ID and the private link. The next, for app and gift card methods, gives you the payment details. When payment is confirmed you receive another email, and when the order ships you receive the tracking email. If you have a status on the page but no matching email, check spam and promotions folders, because the status is always the most up to date source.

### What you can leave alone
A status that is moving normally needs no action. For example, payment detected on-chain will turn into payment confirmed on its own. Processing after confirmation will turn into shipped on its own. You do not need to message us to ask for it, and doing so does not speed it up. Save your messages for the times when a status has not changed for longer than expected.

### When a status asks you to act
Awaiting payment and payment details sent are the two that need action from you, because the next step depends on your payment. If you see either for longer than you expect, pay or upload proof, or contact us for help. If you see proof submitted for longer than a business day, contact us, because it may need extra information.

### Cancelled orders
If you see cancelled and did not expect it, contact us with your order ID. If payment arrives after an order has been cancelled, tell us right away so that we can match it and reinstate or refund the order, depending on the situation.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**What is the difference between payment detected and payment confirmed?** Detected means a crypto transfer is visible on the network but not fully confirmed. Confirmed means we have matched it to your order and the order can be processed.

**Why does my app order say payment details sent for so long?** Because it is waiting for you to pay and upload proof. Pay the exact amount, add your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot.

**Will I be told if my order is under review?** Yes. If an order is reviewed for accuracy and security, we contact you the same day.

**Is there a status for returns?** Returns are handled by our team after you contact us and receive an RMA form. We explain each step by email.

faq.a: Contact us with your order ID and the status you see, and when it last changed.
